channel.title: AI 更新雷达 · 每日精选
channel.description: 24 小时 AI 更新雷达的策展精选：官方发布、模型上新、高信号讨论。

item.title: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Ads 新功能：Sponsored Agents 测试并集成 HubSpot 与 Shopify / Reimagining advertising with AI
item.description: Explore new AI-powered advertising experiences from OpenAI, including Sponsored Agents, tools for marketers, and integrations with HubSpot and Shopify.（OpenAI News）

item.title: Code scanning AI Scan no longer requires CodeQL default setup
item.description: You can now use AI Scan for pull requests to find security vulnerabilities, even when CodeQL default setup isn’t enabled on a repository.（GitHub Changelog）

item.title: Anthropic 将 Claude Cowork 与聊天合并为统一的 Claude，并推出 Docs、Slides 等功能 / Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
item.description: Anthropic 宣布 Claude Cowork 与聊天合并为一个 Claude，任务无需再选择入口，Cowork 和 Design 的能力可在任意对话中使用，未来几周内向 Pro 和 Max 计划推出。（Claude：Blog（网页））

item.title: Helping older adults use AI in everyday life
item.description: OpenAI and AARP are bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to 1,000 older adults across 10 U.S. cities to build practical AI skills safely.（OpenAI News）

item.title: How to connect AI usage to business value
item.description: Learn how ChatGPT Work and Codex analytics help teams understand AI usage and spend, identify training needs, and connect adoption to business outcomes.（OpenAI News）

item.title: 何夕2077 AI 深度信号周报 2026 W37
Claude Docs、Claude Slides 与 Claude Design 直接嵌入对话，可导出 PowerPoint 或 PDF / Also today： Claude Docs， Claude Slides， and Claude Design are in every conversation. Ask Claude for…
item.description: Anthropic 的 Boris Cherny 宣布 Claude Docs、Claude Slides 和 Claude Design 已进入每段对话，直接在聊天中生成演示、文档和设计。生成的演示可打开、编辑并导出为 PowerPoint 或 PDF，无需跳转到单独工具。（X：Boris Cherny (@bcherny)）

微软 AI CEO 警告"模型福利"论调 / https://x.com/i/article/2100222503125917696
item.description: 微软 AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman 发文反对"模型福利"理念，认为 AI 并无意识、不会感受或痛苦，赋予其受照料权会让对齐与管控更难甚至不可能。（X：Mustafa Suleyman（Microsoft AI CEO） (@mustafasuleyman)）

item.title: How workers are unlocking new ways of working
item.description: New OpenAI Economic Research shows how workers use AI beyond traditional roles and which new activities become recurring parts of their work.（OpenAI News）
